findings: The native Windows/Linux/Android/Darwin release selection has no source-level algorithm blocker in the finite clock implementation reviewed. This is not a compiled, linked, concurrency or runtime qualification.
Compared actual PID and thread-local TID native observations with original platform.cc, platform-win32.cc and platform-posix.cc. Integer conversions and the single per-thread cache are preserved.

Compared Windows raw QPC, exact strict-less-than threshold0x8637BD05AF7 and quotient/remainder overflow path. Frequency then invariant-TSC selection, fallback rollover state/CAS and original function-pointer/frequency publication order are retained.

Compared the sole CPU field specialization with original CPU constructor: initial false fields, leaf0/leaf1 hypervisor gate, extended-leaf bound/invariant bit and exact Microsoft Hyper-V signature; Windows ARM64 remains the original true field. Removed probes affect only unused CPU fields.

Compared all TSC calibration statements in time.cc868-925: real RDTSC plus QPC samples, raise/restore current thread priority, static initial samples, minimum50ms returningzero, then measured TSC frequency; QueryThreadCycleTime is divided by that calibration. No IsSupported or wait is inserted into the sampling path.
Compared Windows ARM64 GetThreadTimes user FILETIME-only conversion with original little-endian bit_cast. memcpy preserves the representation; 100ns units divide by10.

Compared Darwin thread_info user+system bounds/arithmetic and mach_absolute_time/timebase initialization and division order. Compared Linux/Android clock_gettime seconds bound, nanoseconds conversion, wall ticks plus1 and CPU support selection.
Compared ThreadTicks public contract: WaitUntilInitialized and Now require the caller support guard; no unsupported-platform capability is inferred.

The four CHECK_OP operand captures evaluate each operand once, compare original native signed integral types and convert to int64 only on failure. Signed/width assertions reject unproved type selections. Current CPP full-byte inverse verified against preserved initial draft using only declared four sites, macro replacement and type_traits include.
Existing function-pointer/frequency and TSC static publication concurrency assumptions are preserved from authority, not strengthened or newly qualified.

ClockCheckFailureOperands and Unreachable remain declared dependencies. Exact Root V8 diagnostic implementation, production linkage, meaningful clock/worker/concurrent/native negative controls and Root-owned runtime remain required. AIX/Fuchsia/Solaris/Starboard and unspecified OS/architecture branches remain unqualified.
